hypothesis: A distinct five-minute oil-shock reversion mechanism may convert BRENTOIL liquidity into repeatable after-cost returns.
decision: Defer the exact frozen oil-shock mechanism and remove it from highest-value external priority. Preserve passive unsigned collection and BRENTOIL market candidacy for a materially different preregistered mechanism.

priority_update.reason: One opportunistic forward lifecycle cannot by itself overturn negative 42-trade development stress, two negative stress folds, both-side stress losses, and unresolved technical paths.

change_proposal.Recommendation: Do not add the exact BRENTOIL oil-shock strategy to live v52. Keep its unsigned observer passive and redirect active external research priority to the predeclared MU transport-parity window.
change_proposal.Why now: The continuous monitor was hardcoded to rank BRENTOIL first even while publishing an authoritative NOT_SUITABLE development disposition and negative stress economics.
change_proposal.Evidence reviewed: Frozen BRENTOIL development replay, three chronological folds, prospective observer through 277 decisions, immutable live-canary friction reconciliation, current external-opportunity snapshot, and the predeclared MU forward-window contract.
change_proposal.Observed problem or opportunity: BRENTOIL remains liquid and observable, but the exact strategy has no demonstrated robust edge and was consuming the top research slot despite contrary evidence.
change_proposal.Applicable market regime: Fresh five-minute oil shocks under the frozen 12-bar return, 2016-bar q95 threshold, 30-bps stop, 40-bps target, opposite-signal exit, and 60-minute maximum hold.
Alternatives considered: Lower the shock threshold: rejected as post-observation tuning that would change the hypothesis.
Open validation despite failed development stress: rejected because it spends untouched evidence on an unsupported candidate.
Remove BRENTOIL market data capture: deferred because passive unsigned data can support a genuinely different future mechanism.
Restore retired Swing or breakout-pressure routes: rejected by incompatible or largest-winner-dependent live evidence.
change_proposal.Expected upside: Stops low-value research looping while preserving reversible evidence collection and focusing validation on v52 live translation plus the fixed MU source-parity blocker.
Main risks and failure modes: A future weekday oil shock could reveal that current live friction is materially better than development stress.
Passive collection may continue consuming storage without producing eligible entries.
A new BRENTOIL mechanism could be incorrectly conflated with this rejected identity.
Validation completed: Observed report-only external monitor output reproduced the incorrect hardcoded rank.
TDD regressions cover negative stress and independently unresolved technical paths.

Success metrics: BRENTOIL exact oil-shock no longer appears as the highest-value external investigation.

change_proposal.Confidence level: High confidence in the arithmetic, source identity, and research-priority defect; medium confidence that passive collection remains worth its storage cost; low confidence in BRENTOIL oil-shock profitability.
